name: Motorcycle Simulator Indiana
summary:
Ride Indianapolis, Indiana, from the seat - alone or with your friends.

34 KM ROUND INDIANAPOLIS
East on I-70 along the south edge of downtown past Lucas Oil Stadium, with the Statehouse dome and Salesforce Tower over the rooftops. South on I-65 past Fountain Square and Garfield Park, then west on the I-465 beltway over the White River and back around to your garage.
